name: web-butter-yellow-bento-portfolio-with-condensed-black-type
title: Butter-yellow rounded bento site inside a charcoal frame with heavy condensed headlines
whatItIs: A charcoal-framed page with a pill nav and rounded butter-yellow cards: a big card 'BIG IDEAS, BEAUTIFULLY EXECUTED.' with two buttons beside a photo of two women on a rug, stat cards (60+, 98%) and a dark availability card, a services ticker, an about card with a photo and tag chips, a trusted-by row and a dark footer.
whatItMeans: Warm and confident; yellow cards on charcoal feel bold yet friendly.
techniques: Build a bento of rounded yellow cards.
Set headings in heavy condensed caps.
Switch one card to dark for contrast.
Run a services ticker between rows.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded tile in a grid.
A strip of scrolling service names.
A tile showing whether taking clients.
A dark border around a page.
